changes.summary: Intuit token exchange uses Basic client authentication; refresh requests respect the configured credential location without duplicating credentials in the body.
Profile endpoints must return a JSON object; any other response now throws 'Profile endpoint returned an invalid object'.
ProfileRequestConfig accepts authIn 'body' together with tokenParamName, includeClientCredentials and validateResponse, so a provider can send the token in a POST body and check the response.

providers.hubspot looks up the signed-in portal by POSTing to HubSpot's /oauth/2026-09/token/introspect with the app's client credentials, rejects inactive tokens or a missing hub_id, and strips echoed tokens from the profile. Tokens are exchanged at /oauth/2026-09/token and refresh tokens are revoked at /oauth/2026-03/token/revoke.
Register Neon as a built-in OAuth provider with typed credentials, PKCE, profile, refresh and revocation support
